name: Pad Thai
description: Stir-fried rice noodles with egg, tofu, shrimp and tamarind sauce — sweet, sour and salty in one wok.

name: Nasi Goreng
description: Indonesia's fragrant fried rice, cooked with kecap manis, aromatics and vegetables, often topped with a fried egg.

name: Croissant
description: Buttery, flaky viennoiserie — the essential companion to a Parisian café breakfast.

name: Pizza Napoletana
description: Thin-crust wood-fired pizza from Naples with San Marzano tomatoes, mozzarella and fresh basil.

name: Sushi
description: Vinegared rice topped or rolled with fresh seafood and vegetables — a defining part of Japanese cuisine.

name: Cheeseburger
description: A griddled beef patty with melted cheese in a soft bun, commonly served with pickles and fries.

name: Mohinga
description: Myanmar's beloved fish-based noodle soup, simmered with lemongrass and aromatics and often served with crispy fritters.
